purpose: Canonical logical schema for the Text2me personal workspace prototype. This describes relationships; it does not mean server storage is implemented.

fields.title: string
fields.name: string (legacy alias of title)
fields.documentId: optional related workspace document ID; not a library record ID
fields.libraryId: optional source ID in text2me.space.v1; deleting this workspace entity must not delete the source record

fields.title: string
fields.name: string (legacy alias of title)
fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD or empty (legacy alias of due)

relationships.case.contactIds: Many-to-many: a case can have several contacts.
relationships.document.caseId: Many documents can belong to one case; deleting a case clears this reference.
relationships.task.caseId: Many tasks can belong to one case; deleting a case clears this reference.
relationships.event.caseId: Many events can belong to one case; deleting a case clears this reference.
relationships.task.documentId: Optional link to a canonical workspace document; deleting the workspace document clears this reference.
relationships.event.documentId: Optional link to a canonical workspace document; deleting the workspace document clears this reference.
relationships.delete_contact: Remove the contact ID from every entity contactIds array.
relationships.delete_library_source: Unlinking a workspace entity must not silently delete the original item in text2me.space.v1.

roadmap.scope: Canonical local model for cases, contacts, documents, tasks, events and activity; relationships are validated in the browser.
The IndexedDB/localStorage file vault remains a separate source; libraryId identifies the source record.
Requires backend, authentication, authorization, server-side validation and secure storage.
Define relational schema, API, ownership rules, migrations, audit log, backup/restore and conflict handling before implementation.
Requires notification service and explicit user opt-in.
Separate metadata/archive validation workflows; source data import is not assumed live.
Needs OCR engine, file-processing limits and malware scanning.
Requires accounts, sharing model, audit log and access controls.

privacy_rules: Do not place sensitive personal data in public repository files.
Browser-local data may be lost when browser storage is cleared.
Exported JSON backups may contain personal data; store them securely.
Never claim local reminders run when the page is closed.
Server-side personal data processing requires a documented purpose, data minimization, retention rules, access controls and jurisdiction-specific compliance review.
A server migration must not upload local data without explicit user action and an authenticated destination account.
